title: Finite locally free modules are complete
statement: For any finite locally free integral coefficient module M on any scheme X, using [def-per-integral-lisse-reduction-data], the cone of canonical projections from M to its actual positive scalar-cokernel tower is limiting. The rank may be zero or vary on covering members.

proof.text: Identify the coefficient unit quotient tower with the finite coefficient unit tower by cokernel uniqueness. The coefficient limit is limiting after evaluation and forgetting to sets, hence as a module cone. The completion natural transformation is invertible on the unit and therefore on finite coproducts, since its source and target functors are additive. Slice restriction preserves these limits and cokernels, so a finite free chart transports completeness to each member of a trivializing cover of M. The map from M to the chosen tower limit is invertible on this cover. The sheaf isomorphism criterion makes it globally invertible, which proves the original cone limiting. All arguments include rank zero and empty covers.
